## `lr-country-picker`

Style the label with `--lr-form-control-label-font-size`, `--lr-form-control-label-font-weight`, and
`--lr-form-control-label-color`.

Attribute `label-display` (`'visible'` default, or `'hidden'`) removes the label visually while it stays the accessible name; hint and error are unaffected (see "Hiding the label visually: `label-display`").

`labelPlacement: 'top' | 'start' = 'top'` (attribute `label-placement`, reflected) puts the label in an inline-start column sized by `--lr-form-control-label-inline-size` (default `30%`) and `--lr-form-control-label-gap` (default `var(--lr-space-m)`), returning above the field below `--lr-form-control-label-collapse-inline-size` (default `var(--lr-size-20rem)`); see "Label beside the field: `label-placement`".

A form-associated country/territory selector with localized names and decorative emoji flags.
Import `@aceshooting/lyra-ui/components/lr-country-picker.js`. The default catalog is the pinned
249-code ISO alpha-2 list. `value` defaults to `''`; valid two-letter values are trimmed and
uppercased, and no country is inferred. `.countries` accepts
`LyraCountryCatalog = readonly string[] | readonly LyraCountryEntry[]`; the entry and headless
catalog helper are documented in the
[catalog helper reference](https://github.com/aceshooting/lyra-ui/blob/main/packages/lyra-ui/llms/forms.md#country-time-zone-and-unit-catalog-helpers).

Country, currency, unit and time-zone pickers also expose `<name>-picker-register.js` under their
granular component directory. These lean entries register the picker alone; import `lr-select.js`
and `lr-option.js` for both ordinary and searchable controls. The searchable `lr-combobox` loads when needed
without registering option itself.
The default picker entries register select and option synchronously.

Listen on the country picker in compact or searchable mode for `lr-show` and `lr-hide` requests
and their settled `lr-after-show` and `lr-after-hide` events. Cancel an ordinary popup request
with `preventDefault()`. `lr-activate` carries the activated country code in `detail.value`,
including a repeated pick. `lr-clear` fires when the clear button empties the selection.

`flags` defaults to `true`; set `.flags = false` or `flags="false"` to hide flags in both the
trigger and offered rows. Emoji need no optional peer, assets or network request. Platform fonts
may display regional-indicator letters; the visible country name remains the identifying text.
The `flag` CSS part styles decorative flags in both locations.

**Shared field contract.** The country, time-zone and unit pickers compose `lr-select` by default
and `lr-combobox` when `searchable` is `true` (default `false`). Their catalogs are copied and
frozen; reassign to change rows. Omitted, `undefined` or `null` restores defaults, and `[]` offers
no options. At most 1024 input rows are examined; invalid rows are skipped, the first valid
normalized identifier wins, and caller order is preserved. `group` adds headings for contiguous
rows, `disabled` prevents selection, and literal `label` overrides include explicit empty strings.
A nonempty unknown, malformed or disabled selected value stays visible and invalid until cleared
or replaced. It is never silently replaced or added as a selectable row.

A localized `catalogPickerInputLimit` notice in `part="limit"` reports original catalog positions
omitted beyond the 1,024-position inspection ceiling. Invalid and duplicate positions inside the
prefix still consume that allowance. This notice is separate from `select-option-overflow`, which
counts admitted rows outside the popup's render window. Search covers only admitted entries;
provide a narrower or replacement catalog to include omitted input. Rebinding the picker's retained
catalog snapshot preserves the notice; a fresh below-limit catalog, `[]`, or restoring defaults
clears it. Initial mounting and reconnecting are quiet; later changed input loss is politely
announced. The message supports the usual per-instance `.strings` override.

All four regional pickers mount only the committed option before first focus or opening, then
reuse the initialized catalog until its inputs change. An explicit `requestUpdate()` refreshes
consumer presentation overrides. Popup rendering is capped at 1,000 options, with omitted rows
reported through `select-option-overflow`; source admission still accepts up to 1,024 rows.
Built-in catalogs remain fully available. Enable `searchable` to filter admitted custom catalog
entries outside the initial popup window; committed tail values remain represented.

**SSR:** All three render declarative shadow DOM with the committed option and identifier, without
browser globals. Country flag emoji need no asset loader. Interactive selection and the remaining
catalog require hydration; use the same explicit catalog and locale on server and client.

`label=''`, `hint=''`, `errorText=''` (`error-text`) and the `label`, `hint`, `error` slots supply
field chrome. `accessibleLabel=null` (attribute `aria-label`) overrides the actual control's name;
otherwise labels or the localized Country, Time zone or Unit name apply. External
`aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` relationships are forwarded to the control.
`placeholder` defaults to localized Select; an explicit empty string stays empty.
`size='m'`, `clearable=false`, `topLayer=false` (`top-layer`), and optional
`positioningStrategy: 'fixed' | 'absolute'` (`positioning-strategy`) follow the select contract.
An omitted positioning strategy inherits `--lr-positioning-strategy`, else both modes use `absolute`.
The filter control (`lr-combobox`) loads the first time `searchable` is enabled, so a plain picker
never ships it. `await picker.updateComplete` waits for the load to settle. On failure the
picker emits `lr-load-error` and keeps the compact control available, with a localized
`search-error` notice and a `search-retry` button. The notice uses `catalogPickerSearchLoadFailed`.
A committed `disabled`
entry stays visible and invalid with a "not in catalog" badge in all four pickers.

`name`, `form`, `required`, `disabled`, `value`, `defaultValue`, fieldset disablement and native
form submission/reset follow the shared form contracts. The form owns the committed identifier,
never filter text. `getForm()`, `checkValidity()`, `reportValidity()` and
`setCustomValidity(message)` operate on the outer field. `customError: string | null = null`
(`custom-error`, reflected) supplies a consumer error; `resetValidity()` clears that error and
rechecks current constraints without changing the value or interaction state. Reset restores
the normalized default and clears transient filtering while preserving a custom error.
`focus(options?)`, `blur()` and `click()` forward to the visible control.

In searchable mode, typing filters identifiers and display names; unit symbols are also matched.
It emits no selection event and cannot create a value. A query matching the current displayed
label follows the combobox convention of showing the full list. Mode changes, reset and reconnect
clear unfinished filtering. Native guidance forwards `autocomplete='off'`, `inputMode=''`
(`inputmode`), `enterKeyHint=''` (`enterkeyhint`), `spellcheck=false`, `autocapitalize=''`,
and `autocorrect=true` (HTML `on`/`off`).
The readonly `input: HTMLInputElement | null` exposes the filter, or null in compact mode.
After directly editing its DOM value, dispatch a native `input` event to refilter. Keyboard
selection, disabled-row navigation, IME handling and popup behavior follow the composed control.

**Events:** `lr-change-request` (cancelable, `detail: { value, previousValue }`; vetoes or lets a
listener resolve a user choice or clear by assigning `value`, as in `lr-currency-picker`), `input`,
`lr-input`, `change`, `lr-change`, `focus`, `blur`, `lr-invalid`.
`lr-show` proposes opening the options and can be vetoed. `lr-hide` proposes closing them and can
be vetoed during an ordinary close. `lr-after-show` and `lr-after-hide` report completion.
`lr-activate` reports activation of an enabled option, including reselection. `lr-clear` reports
that the clear action emptied the selection. `lr-load-error` reports a failure to load the optional
searchable picker. The compact control remains available.

An accepted user choice or clear synchronously updates the form value, then emits one
`input`, `lr-input`, `change`, `lr-change` sequence. Prefixed details have readonly `value: string`
and `previousValue: string`, exported as `LyraCountryChangeDetail`, `LyraTimeZoneChangeDetail`
and `LyraUnitChangeDetail` from their respective component modules. Reselecting the current value,
programmatic updates, catalog/locale changes and resets emit no selection events. Native `focus`
and `blur` relay once; canceling `lr-invalid` suppresses native validation UI.

**CSS parts:** `form-control`, `form-control-label`, `hint`, `error`, `limit` (original catalog
input-loss notice), `select-trigger`,
`select-display-input`, `select-listbox`, `select-option`, `select-option-overflow`, `select-option-sub`, `select-group-label`
`select-clear-button`, `search-error`, and `search-retry`; country additionally exposes `flag`.
Supply options through the catalog property. Shared form-control and surface tokens apply,
including RTL and dark themes. `--lr-form-control-invalid-border-color` themes the resting invalid border.

```html
<script type="module">
  import '@aceshooting/lyra-ui/components/lr-country-picker.js';
</script>
<lr-country-picker name="country" label="Country" searchable></lr-country-picker>
```

- `--lr-form-control-label-gap` also spaces a label above the field (see "Field and group label typography" in `llms/forms.md`).
